answer: Precondition: every submission carries a fresh nonce, so a recorded answer cannot be replayed under a new identity. Each epoch the protocol samples one submission in twenty and re-audits it against the stored inputs. The bridge from work to reward is a vesting stream paid over later epochs, not at once. That prices a sybil voyage in float: the attacker funds many accounts and waits, and the velvet surface of growing balances hides nothing once the sample lands on one with no work behind it.
